description: This file contains serialization, surrogate, and copying logic for SortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> in Orleans.Serialization framework, including codec, surrogate, and copier classes.

classes.name: SortedDictionaryCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Serializer class for SortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> that converts to and from a surrogate.

classes.name: SortedDictionarySurrogate<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Surrogate struct for serializing SortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> including its values and comparer.

classes.name: SortedDictionaryCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Deep copier class for SortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> that handles copying with context.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate back into a SortedDictionary<TKey, TValue>.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a SortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> into its surrogate form for serialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a SortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> using the provided context.
